req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 404 status code when a player with a given ID does not exist. This behavior needs to be verified through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_get_existing_player_by_id
preconditions: Player with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' exists in the database.
expected: Response contains player data with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['id'] == '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'

tests.name: test_get_nonexistent_player_by_id
preconditions: No player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_boundary_case
preconditions: Player with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d1')
assert response.status_code == 404
